source:
Study(
    title="Momentum Strategy on Hyperliquid",
)

Subjects(
    s1=Strategy("keel/momentum_hyperliquid@1"),
)

Run(
    days=Days("2025-11-18", "2026-11-18"),
    split=Split("2026-07-20"),
    coins=Coins(["AAVE", "ADA", "ARB", "AVAX", "BCH", "BNB", "BTC", "CHIP", "CRV", "DOGE", "DYDX", "ENA", "ETH", "FARTCOIN", "FET", "GRAM", "HYPE", "JTO", "JUP", "LINK", "LIT", "LTC", "MET", "MON", "MORPHO", "NEAR", "ONDO", "PAXG", "PENDLE", "PENGU", "PUMP", "SOL", "SPX", "SUI", "TAO", "TIA", "TRUMP", "TRX", "UNI", "VVV", "WIF", "WLD", "WLFI", "XLM", "XMR", "XPL", "XRP", "ZEC", "kBONK", "kPEPE"], chosen=SubjectUniverse("s1")),
    costs=Costs(fee=0.00045, slippage=0.00045),
    data=Data("snap_d96e8eccc0bce098"),
)

Steps(
    map=SettingsGrid(axes=[SettingAxis("var[selection].step[0].branch[momentum_filter].step[0].period", [5, 7, 10, 14, 18, 21, 28, 35], name="lookback", stamp=Stamp("ROC", version=1, param="period", value=14, written=True)), SettingAxis("step[1].branch[vol].step[0].window", ["10d", "20d", "36d", "50d", "70d", "90d"], name="vol window", stamp=Stamp("ReturnVolatility", version=1, param="window", value="36d", written=True))]),
    split=SplitCompare(grid="map"),
    nearby=Neighbours(grid="map"),
)

Views(
    Page(default="Lookback × vol window", switch=["Lookback × vol window", "Before vs after the split", "Every setting"]),
    Heatmap("Lookback × vol window", of="map", x=Axis("vol window"), y=Axis("lookback"), colour=Raw(Control("measure", "sharpe", options=["sharpe", "cagr", "max_drawdown"])), marks=[Ring(Yours()), Box(Selected())], select="cell"),
    Scatter("Before vs after the split", of="split", x=Raw("sharpe_before"), y=Raw("sharpe_after")),
    Distribution("Every setting", of="map", x=Raw("sharpe"), marker=Final("map", measure="sharpe", at={"lookback": 14, "vol window": "36d"})),
    Heatmap("The selected setting and its neighbours", of="nearby", x=Axis("vol window"), y=Axis("lookback"), colour=Raw("sharpe"), marks=[Ring(Yours())]),
    Curve("Across lookback", of="map", x=Axis("lookback"), y=Raw("sharpe"), where=Is("vol window", Selected("vol window"))),
    Curve("Across vol window", of="map", x=Axis("vol window"), y=Raw("sharpe"), where=Is("lookback", Selected("lookback"))),
)
